# Requirements Quality Checklist

## Requirement ID Coverage

- [x] All requirements use REQ-XXX format.
- [x] IDs are unique and sequential.

## Testability

- [x] Every requirement has directly testable behavior.
- [x] Acceptance scenarios use Given/When/Then.

## Completeness

- [x] Scope baseline is complete.
- [x] User stories are prioritized.
- [x] Functional requirements cover the phased refactor.
- [x] Success criteria are measurable.

## Constitution Alignment

- [x] Behavior, threading, privacy, persistence, and compatibility principles are referenced.
- [x] Analysis-only constraints are lifted for explicitly phased implementation.
